definitions.explanation: An unpleasant or painful experience; suffering mistreatment or hardship.

examples.english: I fell victim to fraud and had an awful experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{散々|さんざん}→散々：10323_sanzan⟧{酷|ひど}い{目|め}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{遭|あ}わされた。
examples.english: I was put through terrible experiences by him time and again.

notes:
{酷|ひど}い{目|め} is a common expression for bad experiences.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {酷|ひど}い{目|め}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧: to have a terrible experience
- {酷|ひど}い{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to experience something terrible
- {酷|ひど}い{目|め}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}わせる→遭う：09500_au⟧: to put someone through a terrible experience

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦{目|め}に{遭|あ}う→目に遭う：25927_meniau⟧: to learn a painful lesson
- ⟦{嫌|いや}→嫌：10232_iya⟧な⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have an unpleasant experience
- ⟦{苦|にが}い{経験|けいけん}→苦い経験：09982_nigaikeiken⟧: bitter experience

WRITING:
{酷|ひど}い is often written in hiragana as ⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧.
